hero.subTagline: A targeted engagement to grow Latched Agency's organic search presence, dominate cannabis marketing keywords, and generate a consistent pipeline of inbound leads from SEO.

about.heading: About Us
about.description: With over a decade of experience in digital marketing, I've had the privilege of working with 200+ businesses across Canada and the United States — from small local businesses to large publicly traded enterprises. My client roster spans CPG brands, brick-and-mortar retail, e-commerce, software companies, consultants, medical professionals, and real estate agents, among others. Across those engagements, I've helped generate over $500 million USD in revenue for clients through highly targeted, performance-driven digital strategies. I'm the founder and CEO of multiple marketing agencies, and I bring that same operator-level thinking to every client relationship.

overview.headline: The Opportunity
overview.subheadline: Latched Agency is already the recognized leader in cannabis digital marketing — serving hundreds of cannabis brands across North America with SEO, CRO, content, and web design. The opportunity is to ensure Latched's own website ranks as aggressively for cannabis marketing keywords as the clients it serves. Right now, high-value searches like 'cannabis marketing agency', 'cannabis SEO agency', and 'dispensary SEO' are being captured by competitors. A focused SEO engagement will close that gap, build Latched's domain authority, and generate a consistent flow of inbound leads directly from organic search.
objectives: Rank for high-intent 'cannabis marketing agency' and 'cannabis SEO' keywords in the US and Canada
Outrank competitors including Coalition Technologies, Client Verge, and Hybrid Marketing Co.
Build domain authority through targeted, high-DR backlink acquisition
Improve the site's ability to convert organic visitors into booked intro calls
Establish Latched as the top organic result for cannabis agency searches in key markets

strategy.title: Competitive Gap Analysis
strategy.description: Audit Latched's current rankings against top competitors (Coalition Technologies, Client Verge, Hybrid Marketing Co.) to identify exactly which keywords they're winning and why — then build a plan to close those gaps.

strategy.title: High-Intent SEO Optimization
strategy.description: Optimize Latched's service pages, location pages, and blog content around the highest-value cannabis marketing and SEO keywords with the strongest commercial intent.

strategy.title: Authority Building via Backlinks
strategy.description: Acquire high-DR backlinks from cannabis industry publications, marketing blogs, and business directories to increase Latched's domain authority and accelerate keyword rankings.

strategy.title: Conversion Rate Optimization
strategy.description: Ensure that improved organic traffic converts into booked intro calls by reviewing CTAs, landing page structure, and the inquiry flow across key service pages.

keywordAreas.intro: The initial keyword focus will target high-intent cannabis marketing and SEO searches with strong commercial intent in both the US and Canadian markets.

investment.roiContext: This engagement is designed to be practical, measurable, and focused on the right priorities for your business. SEO is a longer-term play — the goal in this sprint is to lay the right foundation, optimize the pages most likely to drive leads and conversions, and generate clear early signals of momentum before deciding on next steps.
investment.exitClause: No long-term lock-in. I recommend a 3–4 month term to allow enough time to see meaningful results, but I'm happy to discuss a month-to-month arrangement after the initial sprint.

caseStudies.description: $630,574 in revenue generated in 7 months vs. $58,306 the prior year. 538+ keywords ranked. Built from near-zero organic presence to market dominance in a competitive niche.
Scaled from $1,699/mo to $23,479/mo in 7 months. 7.57x ROAS on best-performing campaign. Achieved in a competitive niche with limited advertising options.
5.52x average ROAS across 7 campaigns. Grew email revenue from $0 to $45K/month. Full-funnel approach combining paid social with lifecycle email marketing.

nextSteps.closing: I'm ready to get started. The next step is a short call to align on priorities, confirm access to latchedagency.com and Google Search Console, and kick off the Month 1 audit. The sooner we start, the sooner Latched starts ranking as well as the clients it serves.
